workflow_instructions.mode_overview: This mode is for developers working on epistemic types (Knowledge), uncertainty propagation, confidence modeling, provenance, and units of measure. It covers the `epistemic/` and `units/` standard library modules and their integration with the type checker.

step.action: Understand the epistemic or units‑related request
step.details: Determine whether the change involves: - Uncertainty propagation formulas (GUM compliance) - Beta confidence updates or combination - Provenance tracking and audit trails - Unit definitions, conversions, or dimensional analysis - Integration with refinement types or SMT solvers

Review the relevant standard library modules: - Read `stdlib/epistemic/knowledge.sio` and related files - Examine `stdlib/units/` for unit definitions - Check the epistemic checking logic in `self‑hosted/check/epistemic.sio` - Consult the GUM supplement documentation (`docs/compiler/EPISTEMIC_*.md`)

phase.name: analysis
phase.description: Analyze the current implementation and plan the change

steps.step: Identify which epistemic/units structures need modification
Verify that the change respects GUM propagation rules
Check for existing tests that may be affected
Consider confidence combination and provenance merging semantics
Edit the relevant epistemic or units source files
Ensure uncertainty propagation formulas are mathematically correct
Update confidence combination and decay functions if needed
Add or adjust unit conversion factors and dimensional checks
Run the epistemic and units test suites
Check that GUM compliance is preserved (use the GUM supplement tests)
Validate that unit arithmetic still passes dimensional analysis
Ensure no regressions in the broader scientific library

completion_criteria.criterion: The requested epistemic or units functionality is implemented
All relevant tests pass, including GUM compliance tests
Documentation (comments, spec) is updated if needed
